preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have gained owner privileges)
The contract must have passed the bonus time (bounsTime) so users can call receiveBounsToken()

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call sumBounsPiece() with a very large number (e.g., type(uint256).max) for the current day's date string (yesToday). This will set dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday] to an extremely high value. When users later call receiveBounsToken(), the _sumCanGetToken() function will attempt to subtract dayPoolBounsPiece[yesToday].mul(balancePiece) from dayPoolBouns[yesToday], causing an arithmetic underflow that will revert all bonus distribution transactions, effectively locking user rewards.
